answer: Each new identity must file one unique work artifact in the dune registry, signed under its own key, paying a 60-credit fee that is never refunded. A zephyr beacon assigns auditors to test it for originality. A hollow filing copying another artifact's hash is rejected and its 40-credit bond is burned. The kth fake still needs a fresh artifact, fee, and bond, so 1,000 fakes pay 100,000 credits, plus generating 1,000 distinct artifacts, with no sharing across clones. A rented artifact fails because its signature key differs from the applicant's. An honest agent files one artifact once.
